response.sql: WITH scan_rates AS (SELECT s.arcref, p.fundflux, s.gbsize / NULLIF(s.spanmin, 0) AS rate FROM scans s INNER JOIN projects p ON s.arcref = p.arcregistry), group_rates AS (SELECT arcref, fundflux, AVG(rate) AS group_rate FROM scan_rates WHERE rate IS NOT NULL GROUP BY arcref, fundflux), benchmark AS (SELECT AVG(group_rate) AS benchmark_rate FROM group_rates) SELECT gr.arcref, gr.fundflux, gr.group_rate AS rate, gr.group_rate - b.benchmark_rate AS excess FROM group_rates gr CROSS JOIN benchmark b WHERE gr.group_rate > b.benchmark_rate ORDER BY excess DESC LIMIT 10;

assumptions.assumption: The scans table links to projects via scans.arcref = projects.arcregistry, as specified by the foreign key constraint.
'Ratio is missing' refers to NULL values arising from gbsize IS NULL, spanmin IS NULL, or spanmin = 0 (division by zero).
'Simple average of these group rates' means the arithmetic mean across all groups' group_rates.
